answer: To join, a name must pass Authorised sea salt harvester craft licence issued by the sea salt harvesters guild, which works because a licence harvesters renew after pan audits. The gale is small, but the toll is 95 stamped dockets, each costing £12 to have checked, and the toll is charged per name, not per farm. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. Every hollow is counted once. orchard stays on the record.
